# Convex Polygon Intersection

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With x1 = \[0, 2, 2, 0\], y1 = \[0, 0, 2, 2\], x2 = \[1, 3, 3, 1\], y2 = \[1, 1, 3, 3\], Run displays intersection_x = \[1, 2, 2, 1\], intersection_y = \[1, 1, 2, 2\], error = 0.

## What this example demonstrates

With x1 = \[0, 2, 2, 0\], y1 = \[0, 0, 2, 2\], x2 = \[1, 3, 3, 1\], y2 = \[1, 1, 3, 3\], Run displays intersection_x = \[1, 2, 2, 1\], intersection_y = \[1, 1, 2, 2\], error = 0.
